title: Correction record
description: Corrections never overwrite model output. A correction is a new row referencing the original. Reads apply corrections on top of raw events by default; ?raw=true returns uncorrected output.

event_id.description: The event this correction references. For action 'create' this is the id of the newly created event.

fields.description: Sparse patch of event fields. Required for 'edit' and 'create', absent or null for 'delete'.
